localChanges: In a Civilization II game, the Civilopedia's improvement and Wonder pages now say what each does and where, such as a Supermarket's +50% food on Farmland or Michelangelo's Chapel counting as a Cathedral in all your cities (closes #1196).
The Colossus's page no longer links its Trade to the Trade advance.

log: The corruption and waste rules describe the Palace and the Courthouse, and the production rule Capitalization, with core-rule's Description, from the same constants the rules use. Requires core-rule 0.1.11.
The military unhappiness rule describes the Police Station, and Women's Suffrage acting as one in every city, with core-rule's Description. Requires core-rule 0.1.11.
Each rule that applies an improvement's effect, or a Wonder's that acts as one, describes it with core-rule's Description, from the same constants the rules use. Requires core-rule 0.1.11.

The defence, city-shrink, nuclear, healing, airlift and nuclear-build rules describe what they do with core-rule's Description; rules made by base packages are wrapped in one of their own type, id and priority that says it. Requires core-rule 0.1.11.
Each Wonder's rules here describe what they do with core-rule's Description, from the same constants the rules use, saying where each acts. Requires core-rule 0.1.11.
